description.en-US:
NurVPN — rasmiy F-Droid repozitoriysi.
VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, AmneziaWG va MASQUE protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan zamonaviy VPN klient.

NurVPN — tez, xavfsiz va ochiq manbali VPN klient (Android).

Xususiyatlar:
* 20 ta protokol: VLESS Reality, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, 
  Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, AmneziaWG 1.x/2.x/3.x, MASQUE
* AWG va MASQUE uchun bir bosishda avtoulanish
* YAML (Clash/Mihomo) va .conf fayllardan import
* Ping tester (TCP/ICMP/UDP)
* Ochiq manba obunalari
* Zamonaviy interfeys, qorong'i rejim

Diqqat: ba'zi ochiq obunalar NotFreeNet deb belgilanishi mumkin 
(serverlar uchinchi tomon).
